Third-party libraries, loaded lazily only when a matching file is uploaded (no build step, no backend):
- xlsx.full.min.js — SheetJS 0.18.5 (Apache-2.0): .xlsx / .xls / .ods
- mammoth.browser.min.js — mammoth 1.8.0 (BSD-2): .docx
- pdf.min.js + pdf.worker.min.js — pdf.js 3.11.174 (Apache-2.0): .pdf
